messages:
Lina: Heads up  a couple managers flagged that review form free-text fields are truncating non-ASCII characters (emoji and some accented chars) in the export.

Marco: Confirmed. I saw "Ol" cut off instead of "Olda" and emojis disappear. That breaks context for qualitative feedback.

Maya: Thanks for flagging. Is this happening only in CSV exports or also in the console display?

Hannah: Console shows text fine. The truncation only shows up in roster CSV and downstream analytics pipeline.

ops-bot: Known issue FB-2587: CSV library was set to latin1 for historical reasons. Migration to UTF-8 pending. Temporary workaround: use export endpoint `?encoding=utf8` or download JSON export which preserves characters.

Lina: Can we fast-track a fix? People Ops needs accurate comments for calibration next week.

Maya: Escalating to infra. Short-term plan: ops will toggle `encoding=utf8` by default for the next three nightly exports and monitor for downstream failures.

Marco: Any risk to the analytics job if encoding changes? Our pipeline expects latin1 right now.

ops-bot: Risk note: analytics ETL will error on unexpected bytes if not configured. Suggested mitigation: ETL team to pull JSON export or update parser to UTF-8. We will post a change log.

Hannah: For managers now: if you need a reliable export before the fix, go to Review Console > Export > JSON and attach that to calibration packets.

Maya: I'll send an org-wide note and ping ETL. Also creating a short FAQ on handling special characters in feedback.

ops-bot: Ticket FB-2587 updated: priority P1, assigned to Infra, eta 48h. Notification scheduled for 11:00 PT.
